title: STIHL SHOP Upper Hutt | Helping create beautiful gardens and outdoor spaces!
description: Explore STIHL SHOP Upper Hutt for expert advice, quality tools, and top brands to help you create and maintain beautiful gardens and outdoor spaces.
h1: HELPING YOU CREATE BEAUTIFUL OUTDOOR SPACES.
about:
INDOOR WOOD FIRES

We have Wellington's largest range of Indoor Wood Fires across our three stores from the leading Wood Fire brands including Metro, Masport, Firenzo, Pyro, Maxen, and Woodsman, as well as parts and accessories to keep your fire in great shape for years to come. To make it easy for you, we can help take care of organising the consent and installation process and have you relaxing in front of your lovely new fire in no time! We stock the most popular models, but if there is a model you are interested in that is not displayed below please get in touch as we can order in any model as required.

BATTERY ELECTRIC TOOLS & ACCESSORIES

STIHL has a huge range of Battery Garden Tools that are easy to start, require minimal servicing, noticeably quiet and take the hassle out of gardening. With three ranges to choose from including the ever popular AS Battery Range for smaller gardens, we have a solution for all types of gardening jobs regardless the size of your property or requirements. From around home, on the farm, lifestyle blocks, or commercial use, STIHL has what you need.
